title.en: Top-Down Tank Battle: Defend the Eagle Base

view.en: Top-down 2D grid battlefield with brick, steel, water, ice and forest terrain. You drive a player tank, and the eagle base at the bottom must be protected; the side panel shows remaining enemy tanks and your lives

goal.en: Destroy every enemy tank to clear the stage (10 on easy, 20 on medium, 60 on hard). Protect the eagle base at the bottom: any shell, including your own, that hits it is an instant loss; losing all lives also loses (4 on easy, 3 on medium, 2 on hard). Lives do not regenerate except via the extra-life pickup

notes.en: The tank moves in four directions only; with several direction keys held, only one is used (right > left > down > up); perpendicular turns snap to the 8px grid.
Each shot needs a fresh key press; holding does not auto-fire. Only one of your shells can be on the field at first, two from two stars.
Brick, steel, water, the base and other tanks block movement; water blocks tanks but not shells; forest hides tanks but not shells; on ice you slide in a locked direction after starting.
Each shot removes one layer of brick; only three-star shells break steel; never fire toward your own base.

Flashing red tanks drop pickups when hit: star (upgrade), shield (invulnerable about 10.7 s), fortify (base wall becomes steel), freeze (enemies halt), blast (destroys all enemies on screen), extra life.
Four enemy types: light, swift (fast), long-gun (strong shells) and heavy (four hits, colour changes with armour).

summary.en: A brick-heavy open field with the base at the bottom; enemy tanks spawn from three points along the top.

tell.en: The left, middle and right spawn points at the top flash in turn; up to four tanks are on the field.

effect.en: Enemy tanks shoot at you or the eagle base; a hit on your tank costs a life and a hit on the base is an instant loss.

counter.en: Each shot chips only one layer of brick; line up on the spawn points at the lane mouths in advance, and never fire toward the base.

effect.en: Does no damage; shooting a flashing tank drops a pickup that you collect by driving onto it.

counter.en: Fortify turns the base brick wall to steel for about 21 seconds; stars give speed, twin shots, then steel-breaking.

phases.en: Tanks get more aggressive over time: on medium they hunt you after about 26 s and rush the base after about 50 s; on hard after about 7 s and 14 s.

summary.en: Dense forest hides tanks and shells; swift tanks make up over half the wave; a steel block above the base stops shells.

tell.en: Tanks are hidden in the forest; swift tanks move fast and dash out of the trees.

effect.en: Enemy tanks shoot at you or the eagle base; a hit on your tank costs a life and a hit on the base is an instant loss.

counter.en: Hold the clearing exits and shoot swift tanks as they leave the trees; enemies mostly circle down the side forests.

tell.en: The 4th, 11th and 18th tanks flash red (swift, light, swift).

effect.en: Does no damage; shooting a flashing tank drops a pickup that you collect by driving onto it.

counter.en: Freeze lasts about 10.7 seconds; use it to clear tanks hiding in the forest.

phases.en: On easy and medium enemies hunt you after about 13 s and rush the base after about 26 s; on hard after about 7 s and 14 s.

summary.en: Two north-south rivers split the field into three lanes, crossable only at three fords; shells fly over water.

tell.en: Long-gun tanks fire across the rivers from the side lanes; enemies cross at the fords.

effect.en: Enemy tanks shoot at you or the eagle base; a hit on your tank costs a life and a hit on the base is an instant loss.

counter.en: Hold the middle brick island and shoot across the water; the fords are chokepoints.

tell.en: The 4th, 11th and 18th tanks flash red (light, long-gun, swift).

effect.en: Does no damage; shooting a flashing tank drops a pickup that you collect by driving onto it.

counter.en: Fortify turns the base wall to steel for about 21 seconds; stars give speed, twin shots, then steel-breaking.

phases.en: On easy and medium enemies hunt you after about 17 s and rush the base after about 34 s; on hard after about 7 s and 14 s.

summary.en: Ice, water and forest mixed; forest hides tanks but shells still fly.

tell.en: On ice a tank locks its direction and slides after starting; tanks in woods are hidden.

effect.en: Enemy tanks shoot at you or the eagle base; a hit on your tank costs a life and a hit on the base is an instant loss.

counter.en: Release keys early to avoid sliding too far; guard the ice lane above the base.

tell.en: A flashing carrier drops a pickup at one of 16 fixed points when hit.

effect.en: Does no damage; shooting a flashing tank drops a pickup that you collect by driving onto it.

counter.en: Freeze and shield each last about 10.7 seconds and help you push through the woods.

phases.en: On easy and medium enemies hunt you after about 11 s and rush the base after about 21 s; on hard after about 7 s and 14 s.

summary.en: A fortress of steel walls and water; swift tanks open, followed by heavy tanks.

tell.en: Swift tanks open, then heavy tanks that take four hits and change colour as armour drops.

effect.en: Enemy tanks shoot at you or the eagle base; a hit on your tank costs a life and a hit on the base is an instant loss.

counter.en: Water blocks tanks but not shells, so shoot across it; only three-star shells break steel.

tell.en: A flashing carrier drops a pickup when hit; a red heavy tank drops only on its first hit.

effect.en: Does no damage; shooting a flashing tank drops a pickup that you collect by driving onto it.

counter.en: At three stars you can shoot through steel to open shortcuts.

phases.en: On easy and medium enemies hunt you after about 12 s and rush the base after about 23 s; on hard after about 7 s and 14 s.

summary.en: A steel maze with only a few brick seams; the base has a steel roof, so enemies must reach the bottom two rows and hit the brick wall from the sides.

tell.en: Enemies circle to the bottom two rows and hit the base brick wall from left and right.

effect.en: Enemy tanks shoot at you or the eagle base; a hit on your tank costs a life and a hit on the base is an instant loss.

counter.en: Guard the two bottom-row corridors beside the base; three-star shells break steel for shortcuts.

tell.en: The 4th, 11th and 18th tanks flash red (long-gun, heavy, light); a red heavy tank drops only on its first hit.

effect.en: Does no damage; shooting a flashing tank drops a pickup that you collect by driving onto it.

counter.en: Shoot red tanks first for stars; at three stars the maze becomes straight roads.

phases.en: On easy and medium enemies hunt you after about 10 s and rush the base after about 19 s; on hard after about 7 s and 14 s.
